question: For each visitor who made at least one transaction in February 2017, how many days elapsed between the date of their first visit in February and the date of their first transaction in February, and on what type of device did they make that first transaction?
sql:
SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  DATE_DIFF(
    SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 7, 2) AS DATE),
    SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 7, 2) AS DATE),
    DAY
  ) AS days_elapsed,
  deviceCategory
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0 THEN date END) AS first_txn_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0 THEN device.deviceCategory END) AS deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  HAVING first_txn_date IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY fullVisitorId
